newsitem.title: CANADA: Camco says new product financing in place.
newsitem.headline: Camco says new product financing in place.

text.p: Financing is now in place to proceed with a C$38 million investment in Camco Inc's Hamilton plant, Camco chief executive officer Nathaniel Stoddard said on Thursday.

The investment is related to an agreement with the appliance division of General Electric for Camco to develop a new appliance product. The agreement term runs to 2006 with production beginning in 1998.
The financing is comprised of a C$25 million committed operating line and a C$45 million debt facility with Toronto-Dominion Bank, the company said.
Camco said it is Canada's largest manufacturer, marketer and servicer of home appliances.
